title.narrative: Jordan: Trade for Employment Project:“Improving Business Environment for SMEs Through Trade Facilitation”

description.narrative:
In the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, ITC, the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) and the Government of Jordan are jointly implementing the project ‘Improving Business Environment for SMEs through Trade Facilitation’, funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Kingdom of the Netherlands, within the framework of the larger ‘Trade 4 Employment (T4E)’ programme, funded by BMZ and co-implemented by GIZ.
The overall objective of the project is to create jobs and increase employment by improving Jordan's cross border trade environment, stimulating the competitiveness of Jordanian SMEs and fostering the growth of Jordanian exports.
The specific objective is to improve the competitiveness of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and boost exports from Jordan through trade facilitation reforms, in line with the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA). The project is articulated around ten (10) outputs.
